notes.title: 2.1.7 changes
notes.content: removed the large background images from the tracks, adjusted all vehicles down force, adjusted the AI braking system, updated the core, did a thing with that one thing
Added a few more AI racers, Tweaks to the AI's Camera system, tweaks to the AI's themselves

notes.title: version 2.1.4
notes.content: Added 60 new vehicles, added a few more AI characters, adjusted the duck races, adjusted how adventure mode works.
Changed the tracks foliage renderer, optimizing for the Steam Deck.

notes.title: Version 2.1.0
notes.content:
Added Racing and Battle Damage. 
"With authentic battle damage"

notes.title: version 2.1
notes.content: Added 6 new vehicles. Adjust some parameters, adjusted the AI vehicles, Added unstuck mode for players

notes.title: Controls Update
notes.content: Updated the controls to be more effective and killed a bug

notes.title: Auto Magic
notes.content:
Removed built in screenshot function in favor of Steam's screenshot function F12
Made automatic racing an option on the main menu
Auto Magic is a saved variable so if you turn it off it stays off until you turn it back on

notes.title: Major Update 2
notes.content:
Rebinding has been moved to Settings Menu

Player Vehicles should now be easier to control

Pause was previously on the "T" key for keyboards has been moved to the Escape Key

Quick 1 lap tutorial race has been added

Alert for when the system is paused has been added

Popup box for returning to the main menu has been added to all races and exploration modes

notes.title: Key Rebinding
notes.content: Added in the ability to rebind key. Not only can you rebind your keyboard controls but now you can rebind or bind your controller

notes.title: Suspension update
notes.content: Made some minor changes to the vehicle suspension system.

notes.title: Track Update 1
notes.content: Added a opposite direction for all current tracks.  This brings the track count up to 40.

notes.title: Minor visual and camera update
notes.content: Made some minor visual teaks and camera tweaks.

notes.title: Core Update
notes.content: Core has been updated so we can do some more stuff. This all back end coding that does not effect current gameplay but will come in useful in future updates.

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.content: I noobed out and forgot to change the rigidbody physics - corrected now

notes.title: Menu Fix
notes.content: fixed bug in menu system, hopefully
